name: Ollama (MLX backend) on MacBook Pro M3 Max 128GB: Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit decode tokens/s
methodology: MacBook Pro M3 Max (16-core CPU / 40-core GPU, 128 GB unified memory at 400 GB/s), macOS 26.6.2. Ollama running with MLX engine backend, NVFP4 format, batch size 1, temp 0, reasoning off, repeated 4x with variance under 2%.
notes: Direct head-to-head empirical measurement on M3 Max 128GB (400 GB/s). Under Ollama MLX backend, Qwen3.8-27B achieves 42.5 tok/s decode throughput, compared to 12.0 tok/s under llama.cpp on the identical machine.
